environment.description: Kubernetes pod running with default container security context. The Go Gin proxy is deployed as a sidecar that forwards arbitrary GraphQL queries to an internal Hasura backend (internal-graphql:4000). The backend has no query depth limiting, no cost analysis, and the internal service token grants admin-level access to all tables. Network policy allows unrestricted pod-to-pod communication within the namespace.

config.backend: Hasura GraphQL Engine v2.x with admin secret passed via X-Internal-Token
